# PIXIU: A Large Language Model, Instruction Data and Evaluation Benchmark for Finance

| **task** | Building an open-source instruction-tuned financial LLM (FinMA), a financial instruction-tuning dataset (FIT), and an evaluation benchmark (FLARE) covering financial NLP and stock movement prediction. | “This paper introduces PIXIU, a comprehensive framework including the first financial LLM based on fine-tuning LLaMA with instruction data, the first instruction data with 136K data samples to support the fine-tuning, and an evaluation benchmark with 5 tasks and 9 datasets.” |
| **architecture** | LLaMA fine-tuned with multi-task instruction data (instruction/text/response templates written by domain experts); FinMA-7B and 30B on NLP tasks only, FinMA-7B-full on all data; AdamW, batch 32, lr 8e-6, max length 2048. | “We train three models: FinMA-7B and FinMA-30B by fine-tuning LLaMA 7B and 30B checkpoint with instruction tuning data covering NLP tasks, and FinMA-7B-full by fine-tuning LLaMA 7B with full instruction tuning data .” |
| **data** | Nine open datasets: FPB, FiQA-SA, Gold Headline, FIN NER, FinQA, ConvFinQA, and stock movement datasets BigData22, ACL18, CIKM18 (tweets plus historical prices); 136,609 instruction samples. | “Our contributions can be summarized as follows: 1) We introduce FIT, the first multi-task and multi-modal instruction tuning data in the financial domain, covering 5 tasks and 9 datasets with 136,609 (136K) data samples.” |
| **window** | Validation and test sets randomly selected from FIT (e.g. ACL18 valid 2,554 / test 3,719); no test dates given. | “We randomly select validation sets from FIT to select the best model checkpoint, and test sets for evaluation.” |
| **models** | LLaMA 7B and 30B as backbones for FinMA-7B, FinMA-30B, FinMA-7B-full. | “We fine-tune LLaMA-7B with 15 epochs and LLaAM-7B-full with 3 epochs based on AdamW optimizer (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017).” |
| **baselines** | BloombergGPT, GPT-4, ChatGPT, BLOOM, GPT-NeoX, OPT-66B, Vicuna-13B, in zero-shot or few-shot settings. | “We compare FinMA with following LLMs: 1) BloombergGPT (Wu et al., 2023).” |
